variant_strategy.rationale: A single robust preprocessing pipeline is sufficient for the materials science regression task with descriptor-based features, prioritizing robustness to outliers and skewness.

leakage_prevention.rationale: Target and ID columns must be excluded to prevent data leakage. Target-aware selection is disabled to ensure unsupervised feature selection safety. All transformer fitting is deferred to CV folds to prevent optimistic bias.

column_policies.reason: Target column must be excluded from the feature matrix to prevent leakage.

column_policies.risk: loss of raw structure if site stats are insufficient, but necessary for tabular pipeline
column_policies.reason: Non-numeric structure object that cannot be directly consumed by standard tabular ML models. Featurization is already captured by matminer_site_stats.

decision_rationale.reason: Exclude target column from feature matrix to prevent data leakage.
Drop any potential ID columns that could cause leakage or overfitting.
Analyze missingness patterns to confirm data quality before filtering.
Remove strictly constant features that provide no information.
Filter out near-constant features to reduce noise.
decision_rationale.fallback: Adjust threshold if critical features are dropped.

decision_rationale.risk: Reduced physical interpretability of transformed values.
decision_rationale.reason: Transform highly skewed features to approximate normality.
decision_rationale.fallback: Use quantile transform if Yeo-Johnson fails.
decision_rationale.expected_benefit: Improved performance for linear and distance-based models.

decision_rationale.reason: Scale features using median and IQR to be robust to outliers.
decision_rationale.expected_benefit: Stable scaling for regularized and distance-based models.

decision_rationale.risk: Might drop interpretable features in favor of less interpretable ones.
decision_rationale.reason: Remove highly collinear features to improve model stability and interpretability.
decision_rationale.fallback: Use hierarchical clustering to select representative features.

decision_rationale.reason: Track feature names through transformations for interpretability.

rejected_operations.reason: Dimensionality reduction not needed as n_features (64) is manageable and interpretability of site stats is prioritized.
Target-aware selection is disabled by default to prevent leakage and ensure unsupervised safety.
Robust scaler preferred due to potential outliers in materials science descriptors.

decision_rationale.risk: Might remove features with rare but important signals.
decision_rationale.reason: Remove near-constant features to reduce noise and dimensionality.
decision_rationale.fallback: Lower the threshold if too many features are removed.
decision_rationale.expected_benefit: Improved model stability and reduced overfitting.

decision_rationale.risk: Transformation might reduce interpretability of raw physical descriptors.
decision_rationale.reason: Address high skewness in descriptor distributions to improve linear model performance and distance metrics.
decision_rationale.fallback: Use log1p or quantile transform if Yeo-Johnson fails to converge.
decision_rationale.expected_benefit: More Gaussian-like distributions, better scaling and modeling.

decision_rationale.risk: Slightly less optimal for strictly Gaussian features compared to StandardScaler.
decision_rationale.reason: Scale features robustly to handle outliers common in materials science descriptors.
decision_rationale.fallback: Switch to standard_scaler if data is confirmed Gaussian post-transformation.
decision_rationale.expected_benefit: Prevents outlier dominance in distance-based and regularized models.

warnings_for_downstream: 24 near-constant features were flagged for removal; verify if any represent critical rare structural motifs.
32 features exhibited high skewness; Yeo-Johnson transformation applied, which may alter the physical interpretability of raw descriptor values.
Raw structure object (_pymatgen_structure) dropped from tabular pipeline; ensure downstream models do not expect raw structure inputs unless using a specialized graph/3D model.

model_family_specific_notes.rationale: Linear models require normalized and symmetrically distributed features to perform optimally and avoid outlier dominance.
Tree-based models are invariant to scaling and monotonic transformations, but benefit from removal of near-constant features to reduce split noise.
